criteria.channels: Exact native RGBA differences; zero tolerance for changed protected pixels
criteria.legacy: All 5 eyelid × 3 gaze × 7 mouth states exactly match the accepted mouth pack with neutral brows
criteria.brows: All 16 brow pairs × 7 contexts compare against identical eye/mouth/gaze inputs with neutral brows
criteria.clip: Changes stay within the union of active brow destinations and clips; clips allow one source pixel of antialiasing, destinations have no tolerance
criteria.protection: Zero changes in independently traced visible eye/crease, mouth, nose, hair and other registered polygons; these sampled regions do not prove all hair is correct
criteria.active: Every selected brow yields some changed native pixels; this alone does not establish its intended shape or aesthetic quality
criteria.original: Original mode equals the approved original regardless of brow, mouth, eye or gaze targets
criteria.repeatability: Identical probe renders are compared before and after the complete pose suite
